company_name: Guangdong Huasi Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor equipment, particularly in wafer probing and testing.
summary: Guangdong Huasi Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of micro-nano-level semiconductor equipment. Their fully automatic wafer probers are designed for 4-12 inch wafers, offering high precision and versatile testing environments.
capabilities: Fully automatic wafer probers for 4-12 inch wafers with accuracy better than ±1.5μm
Support for high/low temperature, high voltage, and low leakage tests
User-friendly design with low vibration and noise

regional_presence.China: The company is located in the Songshan Lake High-tech Industrial Development Zone in Dongguan City, Guangdong Province.
